void.$description: Void — Page canvas, deepest surface, card backgrounds — the base layer against which everything else floats

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Section backgrounds, elevated panels, modal surfaces — first step off the canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card surfaces, nested containers, secondary panels

slate.$description: Slate — Elevated surface fill, subtle button hover states, dark interactive variant

iron.$description: Iron — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, inactive icons, low-emphasis body

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary text, placeholder copy, subheadings, icon strokes

pearl.$description: Pearl — Primary body text, card borders, heading borders — the dominant foreground voice

chalk.$description: Chalk — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lavender-beam.$description: Lavender Beam — Link borders, accent strokes, chromatic highlight — the violet signal that breaks the monochrome

iris-glow.$description: Iris Glow — Deeper violet for link hover, gradient endpoint, chromatic emphasis on interactive accents

webgl-aurora.$description: WebGL Aurora — Hero radial gradient — the signature prismatic light burst that defines the brand atmosphere

overused-grotesk.$description: Display and heading face — the signature voice. Aggressive negative tracking (up to -6.3%) pulls letters into near-contact, and near-1.0 line-height lets large sizes stack tight without descender collision. Weight stays at 400–500; the font does the shouting through size and tracking, not weight.

sprat.$description: Secondary display for select editorial moments. Same tight tracking philosophy as Overused Grotesk but with a different personality — more condensed, more fragile. Use sparingly for typographic variety, not as a workhorse.

apple-system.$description: Body, UI, navigation, buttons, cards. The system stack keeps file weight at zero and provides a neutral voice for everything that isn't display. Subtle -1% tracking tightens the default rendering without distorting it. Weight 500 is the default emphasis level, not 600 or 700.
